# gpu-lexer 0.0.2

- Author attribution: Shu Ding at Vercel Labs, as displayed on <https://gpu-lexer.vercel.app/>.
- Publisher: `quietshu` on npm.
- License declared in the published package: **MIT**.
- Published package: <https://registry.npmjs.org/gpu-lexer/-/gpu-lexer-0.0.2.tgz>.
- `index.mjs` is the unmodified `dist/index.js`, renamed to permit native ESM loading.
- Model weights and WGSL are embedded in that file; no network download is needed at runtime.
- Version, npm SHA-512 integrity and SHA-256 file digests are recorded in `provenance.json`.

The published archive contains three files (`package.json`, `dist/index.js`,
`dist/index.d.ts`) and no standalone copyright notice or LICENSE file. All three
files are preserved here. The license text below is the standard MIT permission
notice corresponding to the upstream package's declaration; it is not a claim
that an upstream LICENSE file was present in the archive.
